name: Chu Fei
source:
“I’m laughing at the way you talk about fate, as though you could change it.”

A mysterious boy who appears in Cheng Feng’s dreams. He seems to have been one of Cheng Feng’s childhood friends. Beneath his cold and aloof demeanor, a gentle warmth occasionally flickers in his eyes.
